author: Rainstruck
body:
Hello all of you unknown map makers!!! I just want to say that the group of map makers on this forum is just amazing. I really appreciate all that you guys do for this server!!

The reason that I am posting this is because I would love to start making maps for Avicus and I need others help. I love all of the game modes on this server and I just adore NEBULA!!! I have tried working on maps in the past and it is really hard for me to work on maps all by myself, well because I get lonely in single player and then I end up abandoning projects because I just don't feel the urge to try and finish it. So now this is where you come in!!

I want to make a map for Avicus, and not just any map I want to build it off of your guys suggestions. So What I am mainly asking for is just for 2-3 people to help me build a map on my own custom server. You must be good at being a Team Player and You also must hvae Skype And I am also seeking for some new ideas. If you are willing to to help me make a new map I ask that you respond to this thread and that you also have a little bit of background in building maps. Don't worry about making the YAML I will take care off all of the coding.

So in conclusion I am looking for others to help me build a map for Avicus and I am also looking for inspiration as well!!!

Thank you guys for all of the support and Stay Perky!!!

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body: We are at the stage where maps have become the same thing. 2 monuments on the side, spawn in the middle, some small islands to bridge to, then a huge island in the middle or no island at all. Please leave the map flat so game play isn't destroyed and try to do something different from all the other map makers.
